items.text: Tennessee (Wed/Thu): S Tony Adams (concussion) and RB Tyjae Spears (knee) upgraded DNP to limited. LIMITED - WR Carnell Tate (shoulder), LB Anthony Hill Jr. (neck), G Fernando Carmona (ankle, IR return). WR Wan'Dale Robinson off the report. IR - G Peter Skoronski. Cam Ward practicing, starts.

Dallas (Wed): DNP and expected to miss Sunday - CB DaRon Bland (ankle), G Tyler Booker (ankle), TE Jake Ferguson (knee/ankle), S P.J. Locke (concussion). DNP but could return - LB Donovan Ezeiruaku, WR Jonathan Mingo (ankles). LIMITED - S Juanyeh Thomas (hamstring), S Jalen Thompson (IR return window). Dak Prescott starts.
